quick_ratio.formula: (Cash and Cash Equivalents + Marketable Debt Securities + Accounts and Notes Receivable, net + Current GM Financial Receivables) / (Accounts Payable + Short-term Debt and Current Portion of Long-term Debt (Automotive) + Short-term Debt and Current Portion of Long-term Debt (GM Financial) + Accrued Liabilities)
